frozen_holdout.selection: the same protected indices derived from the existing controlled-split probe holdout_seed/holdout_size; these positions were excluded from semantic member fitting
frozen_holdout.target_policy: canonical lean_regret_matching_policy applied to stored CFR Advantage target and legal actions

candidates.definition: actionwise arithmetic mean of 8 raw Advantage vectors, then canonical lean_regret_matching_policy
canonical lean_regret_matching_policy separately on each member raw vector, then arithmetic mean of the 8 normalized policies
actionwise median of 8 raw Advantage vectors, then canonical lean_regret_matching_policy
actionwise sort 8 raw values, drop one minimum and one maximum, average remaining 6, then canonical lean_regret_matching_policy

weighted cross entropy to stored-CFR target policy
among current-model fallbacks: fraction whose stored CFR target has positive regret
among current-model fallbacks: target-policy max-probability distribution
